features.name: $stringify
features.summary: An stringification mechanism that has an encoding prefix and can expand the macros before the conversion.
features.description: Stringifies, with the given encoding by prefix, the tokens given after the prefix, into an string literal. For macros, it will first expand, and then stringify the tokens that are left.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: The optional encoding prefix the produced string literal will have. If defined, it can only be one of the following: L, u8, U, u.
The tokens that the processed string literal representation will contain.

examples.title: $stringify
examples.description: A comprehensive example showcasing the feature.

features.name: $inline
features.summary: A cross-compiler inline utility with various levels of semantics.
features.description: Serves as an inline hinting, with level indicating the semantic of the hint, or a plain inline in case level is omitted.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The optional inline level of the hint. If defined, it can only be one of the following: never, always.

examples.title: $inline
